text: I understand most of the lectures, but I don't know which topics I am actually weak in.
Online courses give everyone the same learning path even when students start at completely different levels.
I wish the platform would tell me exactly what I should practice next instead of making me choose everything myself.
It is difficult to know whether I should revise basics or move to advanced topics because there is no clear assessment of my gaps.
Personalized recommendations would be useful if they were based on what I actually get wrong, not just my course history.
